title: Open a vault document in local ONLYOFFICE
description:
## Why
Agents need Word and the rest of the office suite inline so a person can see the edit. The BFF office bridge and `deploy/dev/lab-shared-compose-ds` already exist. The staging document server was Fargate and stays off.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`. Topology stays lab-shared-compose-ds (`docs/architecture/portal-document-server-topology.md`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Local Document Server starts from the lab compose
- [ ] The portal opens a docx from the local vault and shows the editor
- [ ] A save callback writes the bytes back to that vault file
- [ ] The staging-document-server Terraform module is not applied
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Local ONLYOFFICE opens a vault docx
- [ ] Save writes back to the vault
notes:
Lab Document Server from deploy/dev/lab-shared-compose-ds (docker compose up -d). Health http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthcheck returned true. DocsAPI loader served from /web-apps/apps/api/documents/api.js. .env copied from .env.example (lab JWT only, not committed). No terraform apply.

BFF env for the editor: BFF_OFFICE_VAULT_EDIT=true, BFF_OFFICE_JWT_SECRET matching the lab JWT, BFF_OFFICE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:4000, BFF_OFFICE_DOCUMENT_SERVER_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,host.docker.internal,localhost. Vault file /notes/roundtrip.docx (fixture portal/packages/bff/fixtures/lab-office/roundtrip.docx).

Browser: signed in as dev@demo.local, opened notes/roundtrip.docx. ONLYOFFICE chrome mounted (File/Home menus, document surface). No error.

Save: POST status 2 to the minted callback with a changed docx hosted on 127.0.0.1. Response {"error":0,"code":"saved"}. Vault bytes matched the edited file (956 bytes). Brain RPC is off, so the callback writes through createFsOfficeCallbackVaultWriter under VAULT_ROOT. Test: portal/packages/bff/test/fs-callback-writer.test.ts.
close_reason: Local ONLYOFFICE opened a vault docx in the portal and a status-2 callback wrote the edited bytes back to that vault file. Staging document-server Terraform was not applied.
